gpt6Votes.why: Explicit UInt128-to-Shares<V,H> introduction closes dynamic share construction without confusing total vault supply with holder ownership or authorizing minting.
A finite tagged payload retains the exact nominal type and avoids an option-record sum whose inactive fields consume node/field bounds.
Exact case projection has a deterministic wrong-case error and does not cast unrelated assets or holders. It is a partial projection; no general total pattern matcher is claimed.
Provides the missing explicit Option elimination. None rejection and short-circuit guarding are coherent under the separately required Boolean /1 semantics.
Explicit widening permits full128-domain products in UInt256 while checked narrowing rejects only an out-of-range final result. No nominal financial value is implicitly erased.

Explicit quanta/mantissa/sign/magnitude access makes numeric erasure visible. UInt128 covers abs(SInt128.min); UInt256 covers abs(SignedAmount.min). Reconstructing a value grants no resource authority.
The exact UInt128 child and static asset index support source-built amounts while keeping actual availability, movement and authorization in financial consumers.

One typed conditional value permits the four-direction vault rule and signed-delta formulas without a host branch. Whole-tree typing/static bounds and selected-arm dynamic work are compatible and observable.

grokVote.reasons: The proposed 48-constructor profile is a versioned successor extension, not a candidate02 freeze and not an evaluator/K claim. The original 40 names are retained and eight pure constructors are added: ConstructAmount, ConstructShares, ConstructVariant, ProjectVariant, ProjectSome, ConvertUInt, ScalarValue, Select, plus UInt256 and the five dimensional tags AmountProduct/ScaledAmount/SignedScaledAmount/SignedAmount/NetAmount. No host callback, implicit Amount/Shares/Rate/width cast, or undeclared match language is introduced. Rule bodies can compute the 35 closed signatures: ConvertUInt widens UInt128 factors to UInt256 before FloorDiv/CeilDiv and narrows with ARITH_RANGE; Select requires identical finite arm types and evaluates only the selected arm; ProjectVariant/ProjectSome reject the wrong case without coercing the other payload; ScalarValue exposes quanta/mantissa/sign/magnitude without retagging units; ConstructAmount/ConstructShares only introduce indexed values. Independently counted reference VaultConversion body has 56 constructor nodes and encodes deposit floor(a*S/Va), mint ceil(s*Va/S), withdraw ceil(a*S/Va), redeem floor(s*Va/S). Independently, U=(2^128-1) gives U*U < 2^256 and U*U/U=U, while U*U/1 rejects on UInt128 narrowing; Select(true,7,1/0) is 3 actual/6 conservative nodes. Option remains distinct from Variant. Boolean /1 is separately versioned from EX-D1. Source AMM uses AmountProduct overloads; reference Σ rule records use bound UInt128 quanta plus consumer role reconstruction. LitUInt width {64,128,256} is a real delta to one preserved constructor and must be stated as such. Approval is of this proposed type/constructor contract only.
